# Cluster Trends

```{ojs}
//| label: cluster-trends-setup
//| output: false

import { linelist, cutoff } from "_data.qmd"
// cutoffDate & cutoffDisplay globally availale from _ojs_setup.qmd

```

## Controls {.sidebar}

**Time bin:**
```{ojs}
viewof timeBin = Inputs.radio(
  new Map([
    ["Half-year", "half-year"],
    ["Year", "year"],
    ["Custom split", "split"]
  ]),
  { value: "half-year" }
)
```

```{ojs}
viewof splitDate = {
  if (timeBin === "split") {
    return Inputs.date({ label: "Split at:", value: cutoff })
  }
  // Return a dummy viewof that emits null
  const span = document.createElement("span")
  span.value = null
  return span
}
```

```{ojs}
//| label: cluster-trends-apply-bin-dates
//| output: false

trendsData = {
  const rows = aq.table(linelist).objects()
  const withBinnedDates = rows.map(d => {
    const bin = binDate(d.date_onset, timeBin, splitDate)
    return { ...d, period: bin.period, period_label: bin.period_label }
  })
  return aq.from(withBinnedDates)
}

// Extract updated periods and labels for inputs and plots below
periods = trendsData
  .select("period", "period_label")
  .dedupe()
  .orderby("period")

periodLabels = periods.array("period_label")
periodValues = periods.array("period")
```

---

**Include data after:**
```{ojs}
//| label: cluster-trends-min-period-input

viewof minPeriod = Inputs.select(
  new Map(periodLabels.map((l, i) => [l, periodValues[i]])),
  { value: periodValues.length > 10 ? periodValues[periodValues.length - 10] : periodValues[0] }
)
```

---

**Group/colour by:**
```{ojs}
//| label: cluster-trends-grouping-input

viewof _groupCol = Inputs.radio(
  new Map([
    ["None", "none"],
    ["Acquisition location", "acquisition_location"],
    ["Exposure", "exposure_category"],
    ["Acquisition & Exposure", "both"]
  ]),
  { value: "none" }
)
```

```{ojs}
//| label: cluster-trends-convert-grouping-input
//| output: false

// Convert _groupCol to an array, which is easier to inject into the plot code with spread syntax
groupCol = {
  if (_groupCol === "none") return []
  if (_groupCol === "both") return ["acquisition_location", "exposure_category"]
  return [_groupCol] // either acquisition_location or exposure_category
}
```


```{ojs}
//| label: cluster-trends-apply-grouping-and-date-filter
//| output: false

sizeByPeriod = {
  const cols = ["period", "period_label", "cluster_size", ...groupCol]
  const totalCols = ["period", "period_label", ...groupCol]

  return trendsData
    .filter(aq.escape(d => d.period >= minPeriod))
    .groupby(totalCols)
    .derive({ total: op.count() })
    .groupby(cols)
    .rollup({ count: op.count(), total: op.any("total") })
}
```

## Content {.tabset}

### Cluster size

#### Row {height="67.5%"}

```{ojs}
//| label: cluster-trends-barplot
//| expandable: true

{
  const barplotData = sizeByPeriod
    .derive({ prop: d => d.count / d.total })
    .orderby("period")

  const data = barplotData.objects()

  // Ensure labels in right order, bc are not dates
  const labelOrder = trendsData
    .select("period", "period_label")
    .dedupe()
    .orderby("period")
    .filter(aq.escape(d => d.period >= minPeriod))
    .array("period_label")

  const labelLookup = Object.fromEntries(
    periods.objects().map(d => [d.period, d.period_label])
  )
  let plotData = data.map(d => ({ ...d, period_label: labelLookup[d.period] }))

  if (selectedRows && selectedRows.length > 0 && selectedRows.length < sizeTableRows.length) {
    const makeKey = r => [r.period, ...groupCol.map(c => r[c])].join("|")
    const selectedKeys = new Set(selectedRows.map(makeKey))
    plotData = plotData.filter(d => selectedKeys.has(makeKey(d)))
  }

  // Configure plot layout based on grouping
  const multiFacet = groupCol.length > 1
  const singleFacet = groupCol.length === 1
  let fxConfig, xConfig, fyConfig, markFx, markX, markFy // To be objects for Plot

  // Lookup for facet labels
  const colLabels = {
    acquisition_location: "Acquisition location",
    exposure_category: "Exposure"
  }

  if (multiFacet) {
    fxConfig = { label: colLabels["exposure_category"] }
    xConfig = { label: "Period", type: "band", tickRotate: -45, domain: labelOrder }
    fyConfig = { label: colLabels["acquisition_location"], tickRotate: -90 }
    markFx = "exposure_category"
    markX = "period_label"
    markFy = { fy: "acquisition_location" }
  } else if (singleFacet) {
    fxConfig = { label: "Period", padding: 0.1 }
    xConfig = { axis: null }
    fyConfig = { label: colLabels[groupCol[0]], tickRotate: -90 }
    markFx = "period_label"
    markX = "cluster_size"
    markFy = { fy: groupCol[0] }
  } else {
    fxConfig = { label: "Period", padding: 0.1 }
    xConfig = { axis: null }
    fyConfig = undefined
    markFx = "period_label"
    markX = "cluster_size"
    markFy = {}
  }

  const tooltip = d => {
    let s = `${d.cluster_size}\n` + `${d.period_label}\n` + `${d.count} (${Math.round(d.prop * 100)}%)`
    if (groupCol.length > 0) s += '\n' + groupCol.map(c => d[c]).join(' & ')
    return s
  }

  return Plot.plot({
    fx: fxConfig,
    x: xConfig,
    y: { percent: true, label: "% sequences" },
    fy: fyConfig,
    color: { legend: true, ...(colorScales["cluster_size"] ?? {}) },
    style: { background: "transparent", color: "currentColor" }, // Registers darkmode
    marks: [
      Plot.barY(plotData, {
        fx: markFx, x: markX, ...markFy,
        y: "prop", fill: "cluster_size",
        tip: true, title: tooltip
      }),
      Plot.ruleY([0])
    ],
    height: 400,
    marginBottom: 60
  })
}
```

#### Row {height="32.5%"}

```{ojs}
//| label: cluster-trends-size-table
//| expandable: false

// TODO: Add singleton back in!
sizeTableData = sizeByPeriod
  .groupby(["period", "period_label", ...(groupCol ?? [])])
  .pivot("cluster_size", "count")
  .derive({
    Singleton: d => d.Singleton ?? 0,
    Pair: d => d.Pair ?? 0,
    Small: d => d.Small ?? 0,
    Large: d => d.Large ?? 0,
    Total: d => (d.Singleton ?? 0) + (d.Pair ?? 0) + (d.Small ?? 0) + (d.Large ?? 0)
  })
  .orderby(aq.desc("period_label"))

sizeTableRows = sizeTableData.objects()

viewof selectedRows = Inputs.table(sizeTableRows, {
  rows: 10,
  layout: "auto",
  required: false,
  columns: ["period_label", ...(groupCol ?? []), "Total", "Singleton", "Pair", "Small", "Large"],
  header: {
    period_label: "Period",
    acquisition_location: "Acquisition",
    exposure_category: "Exposure"
  },
  index: false
})
```

### Large cluster timelines

#### {.toolbar}

```{ojs}
//| label: cluster-trends-timeline-sizefilter

viewof largeOnly = Inputs.toggle({ label: "Large clusters only", value: true })
viewof activeOnly = Inputs.toggle({ label: "Active clusters only", value: false })

```

```{ojs}
//| label: cluster-trends-timeline-apply-toggles
//| output: false

timelineData = {
  let t = trendsData
    .filter(aq.escape(d => largeOnly
      ? d.cluster_size === "Large"
      : (d.cluster_size === "Small" || d.cluster_size === "Large")))
    .derive({ is_new: aq.escape(d => new Date(d.date_onset) >= new Date(cutoff) ? 1 : 0) })
    .groupby("cluster_id")

  if (activeOnly) t = t.filter(d => op.max(d.is_new) > 0)

  return t
}

```

#### Row {height="90%"}
##### Timeline plot {width="67.5%"}

```{ojs}
{
  // Get the cluster IDs to show
  const ids = selectedClusters && selectedClusters.length > 0 && selectedClusters.length < clusterSummaries.length
    ? new Set(selectedClusters.map(d => d.cluster_id))
    : new Set(clusterSummaries.map(d => d.cluster_id))

  // apply table filtering
  const plotData = timelineData
    .objects()
    .filter(d => ids.has(d.cluster_id))
    .map(d => ({ ...d, date_onset: new Date(d.date_onset) }))

  // Compute spans (min/max date per cluster) for segments
  const spans = d3.rollups(plotData, v => ({
      min: d3.min(v, d => d.date_onset),
      max: d3.max(v, d => d.date_onset)
    }), d => d.cluster_id)
    .map(([cluster_id, s]) => ({ cluster_id, ...s }))

  const clusterOrder = [...ids].sort().reverse()

  // Get min date corresponding to user input time cutoff.
  // Defaults to min date if custom split selected
  const minDate = timeBin === "split"
    ? d3.min(plotData, d => d.date_onset)
    : new Date(minPeriod)

  return Plot.plot({
    x: {
      label: "Date of notification",
      type: "utc",
      domain: [minDate, d3.max(plotData, d => d.date_onset)]
    },
    y: { domain: clusterOrder, label: "Cluster ID", axis: null },
    color: groupCol.length > 0
      ? { legend: true, ...(colorScales[groupCol[0]] ?? {}) }
      : { ...(colorScales["cluster_size"] ?? {}) },
    symbol: groupCol.length > 1
      ? { legend: true, ...(shapeScales[groupCol[1]] ?? {}) }
      : undefined,
    height: Math.max(500, clusterOrder.length * 18),
    marginLeft: 60,
    marginRight: 80,
    style: { background: "transparent", color: "currentColor" }, // Registers darkmode
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleX([minDate], { stroke: "#ddd" }),
      Plot.ruleY(spans, {
        y: "cluster_id", x1: "min", x2: "max", stroke: "#dddddd"
      }),
      Plot.text(spans, {
        y: "cluster_id", x: "max", text: "cluster_id",
        dx: 8, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 12
      }),
      Plot.dot(plotData, {
        x: "date_onset",
        y: "cluster_id",
        fill: groupCol[0] ?? "cluster_size",
        fillOpacity: 0.7,
        symbol: groupCol[1],
        stroke: "#000000", strokeWidth: .2,
        r: 4.0, tip: true,
        title: d => `${d.cluster_id}${groupCol.length > 0 ? '\n' + groupCol.map(c => d[c]).join(' / ') : ''}`
      })
    ]
  })
}
```

##### Summary table {width="32.5%"}
```{ojs}
//| label: cluster-trends-summary-table
//| expandable: false

clusterSummaries = timelineData
    .rollup({
      size: op.count(),
      n_new: d => op.sum(d.is_new)
    })
    .objects()

viewof selectedClusters = Inputs.table(clusterSummaries, {
  rows: 10,
  layout: "auto",
  required: false,
  columns: ["cluster_id", "size", "n_new"],
  sort: "cluster_id",
  reverse: true,
  header: {
    cluster_id: "Cluster",
    size: "Total",
    n_new: `Since ${cutoffDisplay}`
  },
  index: false
})

```

::: {.callout-tip}
## What is cluster ID?

Cluster ID is `[year]-[number]`, where `year` is the year of the earliest sample in the cluster, and `number` is the order of the cluster from that year (e.g. `2023-014` would have its earliest sample in 2023, and be the 14th cluster identified that year).
:::
